exposure: External cephalic version (ECV) in noncephalic presenting twin pregnancies
cohort: The study included 19 twin pregnancies where external cephalic version (ECV) was attempted for a noncephalic presenting twin.
finding: External cephalic version (ECV) can be successfully achieved in pregnancies complicated by a noncephalic presenting twin.
mod_finding: After ECV attempts, the overall vaginal delivery rate was 42% (8/19 cases), with no emergent cesarean deliveries required.
